POST /prescriptions/verbal.summary: Write down a verbal or telephone order
POST /prescriptions/verbal.description:
The nurse who took the order (MSDS 55) writes it down at once in the name of `prescriber_id`, after reading it back
(`read_back: true`): an inpatient (`admission_id`) or an emergency patient (the ER visit's `ticket_id`), never an
outpatient, never chemotherapy (`VERBAL_ORDER_INVALID`); the doctor must be allowed to prescribe it
(`PRESCRIBER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`). It goes to the pharmacy and the chart like a written order; the prescriber is told
(`medication.order.updated`) and countersigns within `verbal_order_countersign_hours`.
The hospital pharmacy must be Active (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE`).
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

**Required permission:** `prescription.verbal.record`

**Needs the service:** `dispensing` Active for the hospital pharmacy (destination HospitalPharmacy) (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE` otherwise; GET /establishment)
